name: Heatmap
description: A density heatmap of the host's point features, drawn as a canvas overlay. Points may be weighted by a feature property and colored through a configurable gradient. Toggleable beside its host, so a layer can show its markers, its heatmap, or both.

components.name: Enabled
components.description: Renders a density heatmap of this layer's point features. Useful with 'Miscellaneous -> Hide Main Features'.

components.name: Initially Visible
components.description: Whether the heatmap is shown when its layer is turned on.

components.name: Blur
components.description: Falloff width in pixels within the radius. Larger is smoother.

components.name: Gradient
components.description: Array of css colors from least to most dense. Defaults to blue-cyan-lime-yellow-red.

components.name: Weight Property
components.description: Prop path to a numeric property to weight each point by. Unset weights every point equally.

components.name: Min Intensity
components.description: Weight mapped to the gradient's first color. Defaults to the layer's minimum weight.

components.name: Max Intensity
components.description: Weight mapped to the gradient's last color. Defaults to the layer's maximum weight.
